title: Nairobi City County Finance Act
summary: County taxes, fees and charges for services including parking, single business permits and market fees.

title: Mombasa County Finance Act
summary: County revenue measures for port-adjacent services, markets and outdoor advertising.

title: Kisumu County Health Services Act
summary: Governs county health facilities, community health promoters and emergency care access.

title: Nakuru County Water and Sanitation Services Act
summary: County water service provision, tariffs and catchment protection.

title: Machakos County Public Participation Act
summary: County framework for public participation in planning, budgeting and legislation — often cited in PA jurisprudence.

title: Makueni County Public Participation Guidelines
summary: Guidelines on notice, ward forums and feedback to citizens. Model for county participation.

title: Kajiado County Environment Management Act
summary: County rules on sand harvesting, quarrying, waste and wetland buffer zones.

title: Kilifi County Community Land Support Act
summary: Supports community land committees and registration processes under the Community Land Act.

title: Uasin Gishu County Tourism Act
summary: County tourism licensing, heritage sites and event regulation.

title: Kakamega County Co-operative Development Policy & Act provisions
summary: County support for SACCOs and dairy co-operatives; links to Co-operative Tribunal jurisdiction.

title: Garissa County Drought Management Act
summary: County drought contingency, livestock offtake and relief coordination.

title: Turkana County Water Resource Management Act
summary: County rules on boreholes, pastoral water points and cross-border water issues.
